name: Kefir
siboNotes: Traditional kefir contains lactose and should be avoided during SIBO treatment. Some people with SIBO may tolerate small amounts due to partial lactose fermentation by kefir grains.
preparationTips: Look for lactose-free kefir varieties made with lactase enzyme
Start with very small amounts (1-2 tablespoons) to test tolerance
Homemade kefir fermented longer may have reduced lactose content
Strain kefir through fine mesh to remove excess whey if needed
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in probiotics and beneficial bacteria
High in protein and B vitamins
Good source of calcium and phosphorus
